headline: Predicted risk: No ads (Red)

revenueAtRisk.assumption: Range, not a prediction. Assumes 50,000 views at USD 2-8 RPM, and that "no_ads" content loses 90-100% of ad revenue. YouTube publishes no percentage for what limited ads costs, so that last number is our assumption and yours to change. Every input on this line is editable.

disclaimer: Greenlight locates spans and cites clauses. It does not predict YouTube's decision. YouTube reviews the whole video in context, its systems can be wrong, and it makes the final call.
